title: Aircrew 1939-1945
memorial_details:
description: DEDICATORY TABLET: TO HONOUR THE MEMORY OF THOSE / WHO FLEW AND LOST THEIR LIVES IN / THE WAR OF 1939-1945 / "LEST WE FORGET"
DEDICATORY PLAQUE: THIS TREE WAS DEDICATED BY/ THE AIRCREW ASSOCIATION/ NORWICH AND DISTRICT BRANCH/ TO HONOUR ALL COMRADES/ WHO GAVE THEIR LIVES/  WE WILL/ REMEMBER THEM
